name: [UPD1✨] Youtube Incremental
desc:
Welcome to Youtube Incremental! An Infinite Incremental game with a lot of Upgrades, multiple Features and a lot to discover! ✨

How to play:
💖 Press Buttons to Earn More Fan
⚡ Buy Youtube to Earn Even More Fan
🍀 Roll Runes to Increase your Gains
🔥 Unlock new Stats and many more Upgrades
🏆 Become 1st on the Leaderboards!

Make sure to join our Roblox Group to be aware of whats coming!

🐦 Use Codes "UPDATE1" and "50LIKES!" for Free Tokens!
